g.text: M2: report both groups, including costs of delayed activation
Each cell: mean of two paired relative changes; positive means lower latency. No confidence intervals or winner selection.
* Pacing never triggered in either repeat: do not attribute these differences to a changed admission decision.
k limits fresh activations per prefill pass, not total active requests. All baselines already have correct slot accounting.
